(light record): builds the light's command with elan_light_cmd_build, puts the light number (byte +0, low 4 bits) into word 6 of the command it built (the block is stored in reverse word order, so this is word 1 of the block in the list), and for each of the polygon lists 0, 2 and 4 whose bit (0, 1, 2) is set in the list mask elan_list_enable_mask (the loop shifts the mask one bit per list while the list number steps by two, where the mask is bit n = list n elsewhere, as the game has it) writes the 8 words plus an end block (four 0x08000000 words, list_end_block_count stepped) through the store queue (QACR0/1 0xff000038/3c) at the frame list write pointer elan_cmd_write_ptr, advances that pointer and queues the 0x40-byte block with elan_list_block_queue; callers extra_light_parallel_set and extra_light_spot_set (the game's light set-up); part of the NAOMI2 library; observed live 2026-11-10: in the harness scenario debug_sweep_3 (vertical blank 7025), called by extra_light_spot_set with extra_light (light number 14 in byte +0) and the list mask 0x1f, it wrote three 0x40-byte blocks at elan_cmd_write_ptr (0xaa0026c0, moved on to 0xaa002780), each the 8 command words (header 0x080004e0, then 0x7f7f7f6e with the light number in its low 4 bits) and an end block of 0x08000000 words, stepped list_end_block_count six times (2 to 0) and queued the blocks through elan_list_block_queue on lists 0, 2 and 4 of the bank being built (list_banks+0x13c, +0x1a4, +0x20c)

(count, array of 0x44-byte light records): like elan_light_queue for count lights at once: packs each with elan_light_cmd_build into a 1 KB stack buffer (room for 16 commands; the count is not checked against it), then for each of the polygon lists 0, 2, 4 whose bit 0, 1, 2 is set in elan_list_enable_mask (tested as in elan_light_queue, as the game has it) writes all the 8-word commands and one end block through the store queue at the frame list write pointer elan_cmd_write_ptr, advances it and queues the block with elan_list_block_queue; only caller light_set_send (the game's light set upload, run for the stage set and the rob set in the same frame; it can pass up to 16 lights, where light_send_buf is declared with 14 records and extra_light lies right after as record 14); part of the NAOMI2 library; observed live 2026-11-10: called by light_set_send in the attract demo (frame 3256) with light_send_buf and count 3 for the stage set, 14 for the rob set, and 2 at frame 4843; with count 3 it called elan_light_cmd_build for records 0x44 bytes apart with output blocks 0x40 apart in its stack buffer, and with count 14 the last logged pack call wrote block 13 of that buffer; the enable masks light_set_masks_send had just queued read 7, 0x2007 and 3 for those three counts
